messages:
ram: Nightly eval for q4 bring-up flagged a spike in prompt-set B failures. Seems like unrelated tangents, not OOMs. Repro ~12-15% on CI.

olga: Hmm. Any runtime changes rolled recently? :thinking_face:

ram: Yes — small perf change in KV key generation landed yesterday to avoid hashing long prefixes in the hot path.

ada: Can you paste a failing example from the eval? Even one-liners help.

ram: Example:
```
Expected: \"42\"
Observed: \"Also, when I visited Prague...\"
```
Float32 build is fine. Quantized q4 variant shows the divergence.

jordan: Quick experiment: toggle KV cache off -> failures drop to ~1%. Cache on + batch=32 -> we see the ~12%.

mike: That pattern screams key aliasing: different prefixes -> same cache key -> KV slot bleed.

olga: What was the exact change in key gen? I thought we only changed a checksum micro-opt.

ram: New code used a short-hash fast path for prefixes under 56 bytes to save time. Pseudocode:
```
if len(pfx) <= 56:
    k = sha1(pfx[:56])
else:
    k = sha256(pfx + salt)
```
I suspect some callers are not passing salt when batching, so short-hash path becomes the canonical mapping.

sophia: Also relevant: q4 tokenizer produces slightly different byte distributions vs float model, increasing chance of collision on truncated content.

jordan: I reproduced locally with env BATCH=32 and KV_FORCE_NO_SALT=1. I can add a unit test that asserts no collisions across our nightly prompt corpus.

mike: Short-term mitigation options:
  - revert fast-path and always hash full prefix (correct, slower)
  - require/derive salt from tenant+model+route and assert non-empty
  - add per-request namespace to prevent cross-tenant aliasing

olga: Let's prioritize correctness. Revert fast-path in patch, add a regression test + a small fuzzer that feeds tokenized prefixes and looks for key collisions when truncated. Then we can re-evaluate perf.

ram: Opening PR now to revert and add tests + fuzzer. Also adding a nightly smoke that runs eval subset with batch sizes [1,16,32] to detect this class of failures.

deploy-bot: ci/presubmit  ram/482-revert-fasthash started  running: unit,integration,fuzz

sophia: Add tokenization variants to the fuzzer — include quantized token seeds so we cover q4 differences.

ada: Once CI passes, please drop a summary in #nightly-evals and link the failing artifact so SRE/Product can triage customer impact.

ram: Will post an update after green. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
